title: Task Assignment Observer
instructions: Implement the Observer pattern across `task/observer.py`, `task/publisher.py` and `task/manager.py`. Declare `Observer.send_notification(user_id, task_id)` and update the three channel services, make `Publisher` keep an `observers` list, and make `TaskManager.assign_task(task_id, user_id)` notify every observer with the user first. `ObserverRegistry` is provided.

evidence.label: Observer is an ABC and each channel prints its own notification
Publisher keeps a per-instance observers list
Every observer is notified in subscription order
An unsubscribed observer is not notified
Observers can be added and removed between assignments
Managers do not share observer lists
Real channels work through the manager in order
